    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN central_orders co ON sol.order_id = co.order_id

direct_demand AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.order_qty), 0) AS qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN product p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-2348'
),

bom AS (
    SELECT l.product_id AS root_product_id, l.order_qty, l.order_date,
           c.child_code, c.qty AS path_qty
    FROM lines l
    JOIN product p ON l.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = p.product_number
    WHERE c.valid_from <= l.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR l.order_date <= c.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.root_product_id, b.order_qty, b.order_date,
           c.child_code, b.path_qty * c.qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN product pp ON pp.product_number = b.child_code
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = b.child_code

      AND c.valid_from <= b.order_date
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR b.order_date <= c.valid_to)

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of BK-M18B-52
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-M18B-52'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: children of make_flag products
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        be.qty_per_unit * c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        GREATEST(be.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_code = be.item_code
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = be.item_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND GREATEST(be.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (CASE 
               WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END IS NULL OR 
           CASE 
               WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get distinct parts with their total quantity per unit (summing over all paths)
parts_with_total_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        item_code,
        SUM(qty_per_unit) AS total_qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_explosion
    WHERE item_code IN (SELECT product_number FROM product WHERE make_flag = false)
    GROUP BY item_code
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(p.total_qty_per_unit * pr.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM parts_with_total_qty p
JOIN product pr ON pr.product_number = p.item_code;

),

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of BK-M68B-42
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-M68B-42'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        b.qty_per_unit * c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        GREATEST(b.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion b
    JOIN u_composition c ON b.item_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND GREATEST(b.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (CASE 
               WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END IS NULL OR 
           CASE 
               WHEN b.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN b.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(b.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get the total quantity per part (summing over all paths)
part_quantities AS (
    SELECT 
        item_code,
        SUM(qty_per_unit) AS total_qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_explosion
    GROUP BY item_code
)
-- Sum cost for purchased parts only (make_flag = false)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(pq.total_qty_per_unit * p.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM part_quantities pq
JOIN product p ON pq.item_code = p.product_number
WHERE p.make_flag = false;

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of BK-R64Y-44
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code = 'BK-R64Y-44'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: explode sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        e.qty_per_unit * c.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON e.item_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
      AND GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (CASE 
               WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END IS NULL OR 
           CASE 
               WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
           END >= '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get all leaf parts (purchased items with no further BOM)
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.item_code,
        e.qty_per_unit
    FROM bom_explosion e
    LEFT JOIN u_composition c ON e.item_code = c.parent_code
        AND c.valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')
    WHERE c.parent_code IS NULL  -- No outgoing edges = purchased part
)
-- Sum up cost: qty per unit * standard cost for each purchased part
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.qty_per_unit * pr.standard_cost), 2) AS purchased_parts_cost
FROM all_parts p
JOIN product pr ON p.item_code = pr.product_number;

    FROM product p

    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'

    -- Start with direct compositions from bikes
    SELECT 
        bp.product_number AS root_code,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty,
        uc.valid_from,
        uc.valid_to
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = bp.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.root_code,
        uc.child_code,
        be.qty * uc.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(be.valid_from, uc.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, uc.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = be.child_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND GREATEST(be.valid_from, uc.valid_from) <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (CASE 
               WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
               WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, uc.valid_to)
           END IS NULL OR 
           CASE 
               WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
               WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, uc.valid_to)
           END >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)

WITH RECURSIVE bike_products AS (
    SELECT p.product_number
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id

bom_explosion AS (
    -- Start with direct compositions where parent is a bike
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS root_code,
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        c.qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_code IN (SELECT product_number FROM bike_products)
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively follow children that are manufactured in-house
    SELECT 
        e.root_code,
        c.child_code AS item_code,
        e.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON e.item_code = c.parent_code
    JOIN product p ON c.parent_code = p.product_number
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')

          CASE 
              WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
              WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
              ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
          END IS NULL

          CASE 
              WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
              WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
              ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
          END >= DATE '2025-06-30'

)

WITH RECURSIVE bike_products AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_number
    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
bom_paths AS (
    -- Direct composition: find where SE-T762 is a child
    SELECT c.parent_code, c.child_code, c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.child_code = 'SE-T762'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse up: find parents that contain the parent_code as a child
    SELECT c.parent_code, bp.parent_code AS child_code, c.qty * bp.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON c.child_code = bp.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT DISTINCT bp.product_number
FROM bike_products bp
WHERE bp.product_number IN (
    SELECT parent_code FROM bom_paths
)
ORDER BY bp.product_number;

    -- Get current BOM edges (as of 2025-06-30)
    SELECT parent_code, child_code, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE valid_from <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= valid_to)
),
recursive_containment AS (
    -- Base case: direct parents of TI-M602
    SELECT parent_code AS containing_product
    FROM current_bom

    UNION
    
    -- Recursive step: parents of any containing product

    FROM current_bom c
    JOIN recursive_containment rc ON c.child_code = rc.containing_product
)

WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
    -- Base case: direct compositions containing NI-9522
    SELECT 
        parent_code AS root_code,
        child_code AS item_code,
        qty,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE child_code = 'NI-9522'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: find parents of current roots
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS root_code,
        bp.item_code,
        c.qty * bp.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(c.valid_from, bp.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to
            WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(c.valid_to, bp.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN bom_paths bp ON c.child_code = bp.root_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND GREATEST(c.valid_from, bp.valid_from) <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (CASE 
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to
               WHEN bp.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
               ELSE LEAST(c.valid_to, bp.valid_to)
           END IS NULL 
           OR CASE 
               WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN bp.valid_to

northeast_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        so.order_id,
        so.order_date,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        p.product_number
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN product p ON sol.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Northeast'
      AND so.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),
-- For each order line, find if FR-R92R-62 is the product itself or contained in the BOM
demand_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        no.order_id,
        no.order_date,
        no.product_id,
        no.order_qty,
        -- Direct sales: if the ordered product is FR-R92R-62
        CASE WHEN no.product_number = 'FR-R92R-62' THEN no.order_qty ELSE 0 END as direct_demand,
        -- Component demand: look up in u_explosion for the ordered product as root, FR-R92R-62 as item
        -- Only if the order date falls within the validity interval
        COALESCE(ue.qty, 0) * no.order_qty as component_demand
    FROM northeast_orders no
    LEFT JOIN u_explosion ue 
        ON ue.root_code = no.product_number
        AND ue.item_code = 'FR-R92R-62'
        AND ue.valid_from <= no.order_date
        AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR no.order_date <= ue.valid_to)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(direct_demand + component_demand), 4) as total_demand
FROM demand_calc
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all order lines for Germany in 2025 with their order dates and products
germany_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        sol.product_id,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Germany'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),
-- Get product numbers for the ordered products
ordered_products AS (
    SELECT 
        go.order_id,
        go.line_id,
        go.product_id,
        go.order_qty,
        go.order_date,
        p.product_number
    FROM germany_orders go
    JOIN product p ON go.product_id = p.product_id
),
-- For each ordered product, find all components (including itself) in the BOM valid on order_date
-- We need to explode the BOM for each root product on each order date
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: the product itself (direct sales)
    SELECT 
        op.order_id,
        op.line_id,
        op.product_number AS root_code,
        op.product_number AS item_code,
        1.0 AS qty_per_unit,
        op.order_qty,
        op.order_date,
        op.order_qty AS total_qty
    FROM ordered_products op
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components from u_composition
    SELECT 
        op.order_id,
        op.line_id,
        op.product_number AS root_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        op.order_qty,
        op.order_date,
        op.order_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM ordered_products op
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = op.product_number
    WHERE op.order_date >= uc.valid_from
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR op.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Continue recursion for sub-assemblies (make_flag = true)
    SELECT 
        be.order_id,
        be.line_id,
        be.root_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
        be.order_qty,
        be.order_date,
        be.order_qty * be.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = be.item_code
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = be.item_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND be.order_date >= uc.valid_from
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
),
-- Sum up all demand for FD-2342
fd2342_demand AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_demand
    FROM bom_explosion
    WHERE item_code = 'FD-2342'
)
SELECT total_demand FROM fd2342_demand
```

    FROM product p
    JOIN product_subcategory ps ON p.subcategory_id = ps.subcategory_id
    JOIN product_category pc ON ps.category_id = pc.category_id
    WHERE pc.name = 'Bikes'
),
bom_explosion AS (
    -- Start with direct children of bikes
    SELECT 
        bp.product_number AS root_code,
        uc.child_code,
        uc.qty,
        uc.valid_from,
        uc.valid_to
    FROM bike_products bp
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = bp.product_number
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2021-08-05' 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2021-08-05')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode sub-assemblies that are make_flag=true
    SELECT 
        be.root_code,
        uc.child_code,
        be.qty * uc.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(be.valid_from, uc.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, uc.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN product p ON p.product_number = be.child_code
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = be.child_code
    WHERE p.make_flag = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2021-08-05' 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2021-08-05')
      -- Ensure the interval overlaps with 2021-08-05
      AND GREATEST(be.valid_from, uc.valid_from) <= DATE '2021-08-05'
      AND (CASE 
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, uc.valid_to)
           END IS NULL OR 
           CASE 
            WHEN be.valid_to IS NULL THEN uc.valid_to
            WHEN uc.valid_to IS NULL THEN be.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(be.valid_to, uc.valid_to)
           END >= DATE '2021-08-05')
)
